supersession.correction: The producer source/test pair remains byte-for-byte unchanged from r4. This additive r5 package replaces only the guard source/test pair and records the newly reviewed preflight boundary.

root_cause.r4_behavior: r4 checked the guard before the clock but did not lstat the result, output or derived result-temporary path and did not reject path aliases before the timestamp/claim/spawn sequence.

reproduction.input: A valid local r4 fixture with the configured result path pre-created with sentinel bytes.
reproduction.observed: r4 read one clock value, created the guard, created output, invoked the helper once, then raised result already exists while leaving the sentinel and without a final result record.
reproduction.evidence: Hub independently reproduced helper_calls=call, clock_calls=1, guard_exists=true and preserved result sentinel bytes.
reproduction.consequence: A failed post-event result publication could be mistaken for a valid final one-shot receipt, and aliases could overwrite or collide with inputs/outputs.

authority_boundary.scope: Edge-owned source-only correction to the future one-event actor guard
authority_boundary.authority_rule: A separate coordinator submit-once decision and wholly fresh Hub-owned runtime remain mandatory after r5 review.

unchanged_producer_source.future_build: Hub independently stages/builds this fresh candidate against pinned Fleet Telemetry revision d64c73ab65e7c5fb5fc12b35fe507e2c6054227b and binds the new darwin-arm64 binary hash.

r5_preflight_contract.input_paths: The contract, authorization, binding, helper, client certificate, client key and server CA are all exact absolute owner-only inputs and must not be output aliases.
order_before_clock: Validate every output path against the contract and require its owner-only parent.
Derive the same-directory atomic-result temporary path used by result publication.
Require guard, result, output and result-temporary paths to be pairwise distinct after absolute normalized-path comparison.
Require every output path, including the derived temporary path, to be disjoint from every input path.

lstat every output path before the clock; any occupant, including a dangling symlink, fails closed. An existing valid guard is AlreadyClaimed; existing result/output/temp paths are final ContractError outcomes.
Only after the complete absent/non-alias preflight may the wrapper read CLOCK_REALTIME once and claim the guard with O_CREAT|O_EXCL.
r5_preflight_contract.sentinel_policy: Pre-existing result/output/temp/input bytes are never opened for writing; the rejection tests preserve sentinel bytes and show zero clock reads, zero guard creation and zero child calls.
r5_preflight_contract.race_policy: The preflight is followed by O_EXCL for guard, output and the result temporary file. Any race is fail-closed; no retry or replay path exists.
r5_preflight_contract.result_policy: After the one child outcome, publish the result by fsyncing a 0600 same-directory temporary file and hard-linking it to the absent result path; never overwrite an existing result.

regressions: pre-existing guard is final before clock/spawn
pre-existing result sentinel rejects before clock/guard/spawn
pre-existing output sentinel rejects before clock/guard/spawn
pre-existing result-temp sentinel rejects before clock/guard/spawn
result/guard, result/output and guard/output aliases reject before clock/guard/spawn
output/input alias rejects before clock/guard/spawn and preserves input
valid absent output paths still permit one local helper invocation

required_before_runtime: Hub independently rehashes and inspects the unchanged r4 producer source/test pair and new r5 guard source/test pair.
Hub stages the r5 wrapper in the fresh root with its exact source hash and owner-only executable mode.
Hub creates a wholly fresh identity/profile/runtime and performs a new empty baseline; no r1/r2 root, value, credential, port or transaction is reused.
Coordinator separately authorizes exactly one fresh submit-once event only after the source, profile, baseline and guard gates pass.
future_hub_gate.runtime_acceptance: If separately authorized, prove one receiver ACK, one Edge admission/spool record, Hub durable commit-before-ACK, exact IDs/gaps/frontier, empty post-ACK pull, zero pending/spool and exactly one VehicleName projection.

known_limits: This source/test package is not a runtime, credential, PKI, producer, event, forwarding, durable-commit, ACK/frontier, projection, package, service, installed or production acceptance receipt.
The producer source was not changed by r5 and its prior isolated source test is not live receiver evidence.
Hub status/doctor does not expose application-ledger or sequence-table counts; SQLite error 14 remains an observation limitation rather than a zero-count assertion.
